Getting Started

Estimated reading: 2 minutes 1026 views

Welcome to the PropertyList Community!What is PropertyList?

PropertyList is a comprehensive real estate platform that offers free listings, users, branded microsites, CRM and other tools to efficiently list, manage, and market properties, with additional paid features available for enhanced functionalities. Pay as you go with no monthly subscriptions.

This manual provides detailed instructions and information on all aspects of the platform, from importing your properties to managing sales pipeline, a comprehensive guide to using the PropertyList MLS platform.

Who should use this manual?

This manual is intended for all users of the PropertyList MLS platform. Whether you are a new user or an experienced user, you will find helpful information in this manual. We’re always working on new features to help estate agents close more deals and save time. Keep an eye out for upcoming updates and features!

What is included in this manual?

This manual includes the following information:

  • Creating and managing listings
  • Managing leads
  • Using the Client Pipeline
  • Using the PropertyList Calendar
  • Generating reports and statistics
  • Posting Job Opportunities
  • Additional resources

How to use this manual

This manual is organised into a series of chapters and sections, you can find sections on the left of all document pages. Each chapter covers a different topic, and each section provides detailed instructions on a specific task. You can use the search function to find the exact information you need.

We hope you find this manual helpful. If you have any questions, please contact PropertyList support.
